finite_concept_catalog.reason: It measures whether the absolute open-to-close displacement of one minute persists into the next minute inside each trading half. The complete 138-definition library contains close-to-close absolute-return persistence, body direction continuity, body-to-range efficiency, gap/body coupling and close-location persistence, but not adjacent dependence of same-bar body magnitudes.
It would reuse the exact Campaign077 amount-clock variance mechanism with a field substitution and is not sufficiently independent.
It is a direct profile-similarity variant of terminal return/range/amount half-session similarity mechanisms and adds no new dependence operator.
It is a sparse-price-update reexpression of exact update share, update-clock entropy and exact-close diversity.
The library already covers wick balance, close location, close-location persistence and range persistence; this candidate has higher semantic collision risk than the selected body-only mechanism.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_intrabar_body_magnitude_serial_persistence_238p
selected_candidate.formula: population Pearson correlation between adjacent abs(log(close/open)) values over 119 morning plus 119 afternoon within-half pairs
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Persistent one-minute body magnitude may identify sustained execution imbalance or liquidity disturbance that survives the close and carries into the next few sessions.
